| Pair | Posts with Video Views data | Sum (Organic + Unclassified + Paid = Video Views) | Engagements ÷ Video Views = Video Response Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| HBO Max | 59 of 126 | holds on all, 0 failures | holds on 58 evaluated (largest rounding gap 0.0047 pp) |
| Amazon Prime Video | 35 | holds on all, 0 failures | holds on all 35 |
| Condé Nast / Vogue - US | 78 | holds on all, 0 failures | holds on 77 evaluated; 1 skipped for a "–" component |

- **Sum row:** the column totals match the Sum row's Video Views on all three pairs.
- **Views split:** on TikTok every view sits in Unclassified Views. Organic and Paid are "–", which I treated as 0.

- **Aggregate rate:** the Sum row's Video Response Rate cell reads "N/A" on all three, so I could only recompute the aggregate rate for reference, not compare it to a displayed value.
- **Names:** the dev names differ slightly from the spec ("Condé Nast", "Vogue - US"). They are the same entities and I used them as shown.
- **Bugs:** no open linked bugs, and none interfered. No bugs filed.
